name: router-models
description: Use custom AI models in GitHub Copilot Chat — OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, Groq, OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible API. BYOK with multiple keys and auto rotation, free models, cost-aware routing.

Router Models: Export Providers to JSON
Router Models: Reload from Settings Sync

routerModels.includePatterns.description: Glob patterns (matched against model ids) for models to always show. Empty list means show all models. Example: ["*deepseek*"] shows only DeepSeek models, ["*:free"] shows only free models.

routerModels.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns (matched against model ids) for models to always hide. Exclude wins over include. Example: ["*kimi*"] permanently hides all Kimi models.

routerModels.requestTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for requests made to providers.

routerModels.defaultTemperature.description: Default temperature used for chat completion requests.

routerModels.defaultCooldownSeconds.description: Default cooldown in seconds a key rests after a 429. Can be overridden per provider. A Retry-After header from the provider always wins.

routerModels.maxRetries.description: How many times a chat request is retried automatically (without any user action) on rate limits, server errors, empty responses and dropped connections. Attempts are spaced out with an exponential backoff.

routerModels.retryBackoffMs.description: Base delay in milliseconds before each retry, doubled every attempt and capped at 30 s. Gives a transient network or provider outage time to clear, so unattended (e.g. overnight) runs keep going instead of stopping on the first blip.

routerModels.retryMidStreamErrors.description: Also retry a connection that dropped after the model had already started answering. The retried answer is appended, so the response may contain a duplicated section — preferable to a hard stop for long unattended runs. A failure after a tool call was delivered is never retried (the agent would run the tool twice).

routerModels.autoFavicon.description: Automatically detect and download the favicon of the provider's host as its icon (a manually entered icon URL always wins).

routerModels.showReasoning.description: Surface reasoning / thinking output (reasoning_content, reasoning, thinking, thought) from models as visible text instead of dropping it.

routerModels.syncApiKeys.description: Also sync API keys across machines through VS Code Settings Sync (requires Settings Sync to be turned on with your GitHub / Microsoft account). When off, keys stay in each machine's secure storage and are never synced. Enabling this writes the keys into the Settings Sync backup.

routerModels.freeModelsEnabled.description: Detect free models automatically by downloading a curated list maintained by the extension author. Providers are matched by the base URL's domain, so this works for any provider you add. Off by default; nothing is downloaded until you turn it on.

routerModels.freeModelsRefreshHours.description: How often (in hours) the free-models list is re-downloaded automatically when it is enabled. 24 means once a day.

routerModels.freeOnly.description: When on, the Copilot model picker only shows models that are marked or detected as free (user-tagged, provider free-all, or matching a remote free-models entry). All other models are hidden from the picker. The sidebar is not affected.
